cover: Build or buy: a side-by-side cost worksheet

slides.title: Getting started
slides.body: Buy: setup, data migration and training, running in days. Build: the build itself, weeks at best, and a first version that does less.

slides.title: As you grow
slides.body: Buy: per-seat price as you hire, add-ons and price rises at renewal. Build: hosting, plus maintenance budgeted every year.

slides.title: Hours on workarounds
slides.body: Buy: the time your team spends working around the tool each week. Build: worth it only if it removes those hours.

slides.title: Who keeps it current
slides.body: Buy: the vendor handles tax changes, security patches and new browsers. Build: you do, for as long as you use it.

slides.title: Getting out
slides.body: Buy: getting your data out in a usable form, and contract terms that make leaving slow. Check the API and export first.

slides.title: The middle row
slides.body: Buy the standard parts and build a thin layer for what's specific to you, reading and writing through the tools' APIs.
